name: Dhunseri Ventures Limited
summary: Dhunseri Ventures Limited is an Indian company with diverse business interests including tea and petrochemicals. The company cultivates, manufactures, and sells tea, while also engaging in the production of PET (polyethylene terephthalate) resins. Dhunseri Ventures aims to expand its footprint in both the tea and petrochemical sectors, with its operations primarily based in India.
